headline: Amending use regulations in city code section 12.12.030 and adding an assistant department head salary schedule.
summary: The committee will discuss amending Malden City Code 12.12.030 Use Regulations, including a new use table. It will also discuss adding Section .075 Assistant Department Head Salary Schedule to Title 2, Chapter 24 of the city code.
items: 327-26: Amend MCC 12.12.030 Use Regulations, including a proposed use table, with Planning Board recommendations and related attachments
415-26: Amend MCC Title 2, Chapter 24 by adding Section .075 Assistant Department Head Salary Schedule and inserting new positions
location: Room 105, Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 02148
